# Søren Bredkjær

Søren Bredkjær is named in the ADHD_2023 report as Vicedirektør (deputy director) within the Regionssundhedsdirektørkredsen, tied to Psykiatrien Region Sjælland (Psychiatry Region Zealand) [^src1]. He appears in the list of steering group members for the Danish ADHD database, a national health register that monitors the quality of diagnostic assessment and treatment of ADHD in children and young people under the age of 18 [^src1]. According to the entity's significance description, he serves as psykiatriledelsesrepræsentant (psychiatric leadership representative) in the styregruppen (steering group) for this database. The steering group otherwise draws on overlæger, speciallæger, psykologer, sygeplejersker, epidemiologer og pårørenderepræsentanter from across Denmark, reflecting the multidisciplinary oversight structure behind the database's monitoring of ADHD care quality and, among its findings, the lower rate at which children and young people with ADHD complete the folkeskole exit exam before age 17 compared with the background population.

The corpus contains only a single mention of Søren Bredkjær, with no additional relationships, claims, or timeline events recorded. This is an honest, sparse entry: beyond his named role and affiliation in the steering group listing, no further biographical or activity detail is available in the source material.
